paragraphs: Rabbi Hillel, who said “There is no Messiah for Israel”: Chelek 98b. In Rav Yosef’s time: there, 99a, Rav Yosef said, “May his Master forgive Hillel.” Who told him that he was in Rav Yosef’s generation? Perhaps he is Rabbi Hillel who asked Rava, or the aforementioned reciter Hillel.
